name: Ichijou Suzune
source: The second youngest sister of Ichijou sisters, a natural airhead who likes to make her presence be known. She gets a kick out of teasing her younger brother and trying to prank him from time to time. Is considered to be eccentric and for that reason ends up being avoided by the protagonist and his friends. Wears a track suit because she is usually dieting and goes for runs to keep in shape.
